pillars.heading: Engine
pillars.body: @portfolio-engine/engine-core loads JSON config, validates against Zod schemas, exposes virtual modules, and injects routes — all through one Astro integration.

pillars.heading: Theme
pillars.body: @portfolio-engine/editorial-theme ships layouts, components, Tailwind v4 plumbing, and five named override surfaces with stable prop contracts.

pillars.heading: Admin
pillars.body: @portfolio-engine/admin-tools injects /admin, GitHub OAuth, and content-editing endpoints. Edits land as real commits in your content repo.

ctaBody: Start with docs/downstream/setup-with-claude.md — paste it into Claude Code, answer a few questions, and the agent will provision your repo with DRY_RUN-safe phase scripts.
